allocation_unit: person; change to team before allocation if people collaborate
search_policy: equal public web access for A/B/C
missing_plan: retain all assigned units; report unknown quality and unknown labor separately
source_basis: AF-RES-034 fixed future-study; values not carried over
followup_anchor: t0_packet_first_render_utc; followup_gap must be >= t0 elapsed budget
nonadopter_followup_policy: same t1 packet offered unless consent withdrawn; later completion is initial-work continuation, not initial-adopter rework
success_event: first recorded immutable submission later graded pass on all mandatory requirements and no critical violation
labor_estimand: mean total active_seconds per randomized unit; team units sum person labor
interphase_activity_policy: same allowed tools and support; record all observed work after t0 and before t1
labor_missing_sensitivity: observed-labor lower bound; predeclared finite allowed-activity upper bound if available; otherwise withhold all-assigned labor-success conclusion
withdrawal_policy: stop participation on withdrawal; retain only consent-permitted evidence and report missingness
